{"reason": "6 of 8 failure rows have confidence 0.44-0.67, below the 0.7 high-confidence bar, yet v1 arbitrated them. Adding high-confidence? to the gate should cut the 0.714 false-arbitration-rate sharply while confident true swings (|pct|>0.15, exposure>500k, unfrozen) keep recall >= 0.8.", "source": "(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
